reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Pilot: Traefik Pilot is no longer available since October 4th, 2022", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: workload-failure

consequence.statement: Traefik will not start if any Pilot configuration remains in the static configuration.
consequence.remediation: Remove all Pilot related configuration from the static configuration.

proposed.statement: Traefik Pilot static configuration (e.g. pilot.token) is no longer supported in v3 and prevents Traefik from starting; it must be removed from the static configuration.
